visible_evidence: The whole word בחדש is visible, including its lower points. The initial bet is the rightmost letter. The space inside it, between the top stroke and the base, is plain white with no dot. Below the bet there is only a horizontal patah stroke. The holam on the het, the segol under the dalet and the shin dot are separate marks and are not near the bet's interior. The bottom line's ink (ישראל) sits below the vowel points and does not reach into the bet.
